analysis.title: GS U.S. Industrials & Materials | WWD guide | EXPD analyst day | WCN takes
key_insights: Industrials fell 55bps and materials fell 120bps on 11/17, with broader markets in between. Energy outperformed but still closed lower. Technology lagged ahead of the NVDA report.

NVDA reported after the close on 11/17 and the desk calls it broadly better than expected, a beat and raise with better 2028 revenue growth. US S&P futures were up 60bps pre-market, led by technology.
Data center names quietly outperformed into the NVDA report while airlines and transports lagged.
NAHB housing sentiment printed 25 against 29 expected, the weakest level since 2012. The desk notes 46% of builders are cutting prices.

Architecture Billings Index was 44.9 against 44.7 the prior month, with inquiries down to 51 from 53. Midwest activity drove the index lower and institutional is the weakest end market. Few projects are moving from design to signed contracts.
Overseas pre-market moves were muted: KOSPI +199bps, Japan +28bps, TWSE +26bps, Europe about flat. UK CPI ran hot at 3.7% against 3.5% consensus, and Eurozone CPI was in line but elevated at 4%.

Commodities fell sharply pre-market: copper down almost 400bps, gold down 200bps to $3,770, crude down 100bps with WTI at $84 and Brent at $92. The 10-year Treasury yield is 5.09%, off local highs. DXY is near 104 and Bitcoin is holding $64k.

EXPD holds its first investor day in over a decade on 11/18. The desk called it a long into the event a few months ago and will watch for levers that push 2027 EPS up or down. Consensus has 2027 EPS essentially flat versus 2026.

The desk sees upside optionality for EXPD from headcount reduction and use of the balance sheet. It is cautious about the stock's outperformance into the event and a possible normalization in air and ocean freight trends. 2026 estimate revisions have raised the base for 2027.

WWD reports after the close on 11/18 and must guide fiscal 2027. The desk treats $10.75 (consensus) as the bogey. It will focus on aerospace aftermarket and original equipment trends versus industrial, with more upside if aerospace is strong.

WCN, per a GIR note: on 11/16 a pressurized pocket was hit while drilling a new well at Chiquita Canyon, causing an above-ground release of landfill gases and particulate. No liquids were released. Air monitoring showed no exceedances of reference exposure levels, including benzene.

WCN halted all well drilling across the Chiquita Canyon landfill footprint at 4 pm on 11/16. Drilling will not restart until cleanup is complete and a full review is done with regulators. WCN does not expect the event to affect its ongoing efforts on the elevated temperature landfill event.

Other 11/18 events: ZIM earnings pre-market, CPA and WWD earnings post-close, and investor days for MOD, ROK, EXPD and MH. US building permits, housing starts, pending home sales and FOMC minutes are also due.

Fiscal 2027 guidance is due with earnings after the close on 11/18. The desk sees $10.75 (consensus) as the bogey and more potential if aerospace is strong.

Gas release at the Chiquita Canyon landfill on 11/16 halted all well drilling at the site. WCN says it does not expect an impact on its overall effort to manage the elevated temperature landfill event.

EXPD: consensus EPS is essentially flat for 2027 versus 2026 (consensus estimates, not reported). The desk sees potential upside from headcount reduction and balance sheet use.
NVDA reported after the close on 11/17. The desk describes the results as broadly better than expected, a beat and raise with better 2028 revenue growth. No figures are given.
Earnings dates: ZIM reports pre-market on 11/18 and CPA reports post-close on 11/18. MMS, ROAD and VVV report pre-market and ESE and KEYS post-market on 11/19.
